description: [WIDE] Fix the same integer-division bug in two independent parsers
request: Both csv_parser.py and tsv_parser.py have the same bug: they compute an average using `/` (float division) then compare with `==` to an integer. Change both to use integer division `//` for the average calculation so the comparison works correctly.

snapshot.csv_parser.py:
def average_column(rows, col):
    total = sum(int(row[col]) for row in rows)
    avg = total / len(rows)
    return avg
snapshot.tsv_parser.py:
def average_field(records, field):
    total = sum(int(r[field]) for r in records)
    avg = total / len(records)
    return avg
